description: Case-insensitive search over headlines and summaries of the current board. A query that equals a ticker tag (BTC, ETH, SOL…) also finds every story tagged with it. `matched` counts every match; an answer carries up to 20 of them (`limit`), from `offset`. `has_more` is true when matches remain, and `next_offset` is where the next page starts.

offset.description: How many of the matching stories to skip, strongest first; with limit, a page of them.

name: mcw-search
title: Search the wire
